test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the closest appro×imate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

23.96 + 24.96 + 23.16 - 18.89 × 3.04 + 36.13 ÷ 6.1 = ?
solution:
**Concept used:**

BODMAS

Preference will be given on the basis of the letters coming first in the word Bodmas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f64c9f79d77b59f47195df405b394d1389881df31e18c68888ff4c37e1e42e.png] 

**Calculation:**

23.96 + 24.96 + 23.16 - 18.89 × 3.04 + 36.13 ÷ 6.1

Taking appro×imation: 24 + 25 + 23 - 19 × 3 + 36 ÷ 6

= 24 + 25 + 23 - 57 + 6 = 21

Thus, the required closest value is 21.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 3).**
